'''Goggareth''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the tenure of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]]. When Goggareth died in an accident, the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] circulated rumors that Goggareth's death had in fact been an assassination carried out by the [[Exchange]] on the behalf of Chancellor Janarus. However, such rumors were denied by Janarus.
